main_text.l: VNde nouus rigor in vultu? tristisque seuerisFrons caperata minis, tardiqué modestia gressus?Illáque frenata constans custodia lingua?Quò lepor, & risus abiere salésque venusti?Nec pila delectat, nec rauci in puluere circiFlectere cornipedem, volucrem nec ducere visco,Nec leporem canibus, nec ceruo comminus illuFigere ramosi viuacia pectora cerui?

Sæpe mihi humanæ meditanti incommoda vitæ,Spésque leues trepidósque metus, vanósque labores,Gaudiáque instabilis semper fucata sereno,Non secus ac nauis lato iactata profundo,Quam venti, violéntsque astus, canusque magisterIn diuersa trahunt, tuto subducere portuDecreui quodcunque mihi superesse fugacisFata sinent æui, sanctisque impendere curis.Finem anima, & stolida lacrymis commissa iuuentæ

page.notes: The opening initial is a large woodcut letter "V" joined to "Nde" as "VNde" (printed "Nde"; initial assumed). Some words in the verse are blurred by the scan (e.g. "illu", "violéntsque", "tardiqué"); the line "Frons caperata..." carries a hyphenated break "modes-tia". Lines marked as doubtful should be checked against the original.
